hypothesis.title: CrashLoop: Missing required Kubernetes Secret 'stripe-secrets'
hypothesis.description: The payment-worker Pod is in a CrashLoopBackOff state because it cannot start. The application requires the environment variable 'STRIPE_API_KEY', which should be injected from a Kubernetes Secret named 'stripe-secrets'. This Secret does not exist in the 'payment-system' namespace. The deployment was created at 16:10:28, but the required Secret was not created or migrated beforehand.

recommended_actions.title: Create the missing Stripe API Secret immediately
recommended_actions.description:
Create a Kubernetes Secret named 'stripe-secrets' in the 'payment-system' namespace with the key 'api-key' containing the valid Stripe API key. Command:

kubectl create secret generic stripe-secrets \
  --from-literal=api-key=$YOUR_STRIPE_API_KEY \
  -n payment-system

Once created, pods will automatically restart and should initialize successfully.

recommended_actions.title: Verify the Secret was created and mounted correctly
recommended_actions.description: After creating the Secret, check that the pod restarted and the logs show successful initialization (look for confirmation that 'STRIPE_API_KEY' was loaded). If pods still don't start, verify the Secret key name matches the Pod spec ('api-key').

recommended_actions.title: Update deployment procedures to prevent recurrence
recommended_actions.description: Establish a checklist: Secrets must exist BEFORE deployment rollout. Consider using Sealed Secrets, External Secrets, or a pre-deployment validation script that ensures all required Secrets are present in the target namespace.
